title: Discrepancy lower bounds for small-advantage layered Arthur–Merlin communication
author: Dmitry Gavinsky
work: The Layer Complexity of Arthur-Merlin-like Communication

difficulty_reason: The discrepancy bound must handle protocols whose zero-layer multiplicity is unbounded and can dominate their one-layer multiplicity. The proof develops an iterative set-intersection amplification lemma with quantitative retained mass, then splits the average-multiplicity regimes to produce a large discrepancy-witness rectangle, a nonroutine new obligation beyond standard communication-complexity discrepancy arguments.
